buckets.title: Fitness & Fatigue
buckets.text: A slight edge to Zolotareva on freshness. Zolotareva has 18 games on the legs over 14 days (1 match) against 78 for Burillo (4).

buckets.title: Motivation & Pressure
buckets.text: Burillo holds a clear advantage on motivation and pressure. Burillo is on the way up (+136 Elo over 90 days) while Zolotareva has been sliding (-12). Deciding-set record under pressure: Burillo 62%, Zolotareva 40%.

buckets.title: Conditions
buckets.text: No clear edge on conditions: two factors pull in opposite directions. Burillo has 15 matches on Clay in the last 90 days, Zolotareva only 2, so the adjustment period is shorter. Zolotareva is the more proven player on Clay: 62% wins in 12 months against 54% for Burillo.
